description_en: Retrieves the download URL of the original file for a translation task
description_zh: 获取翻译任务的原始文件下载URL
name: GetOriginalFileUrl

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.
The TaskId is returned after a task is submitted by calling SubmitTranslationTask
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
SubmitTranslationTask任务提交后会返回TaskId
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The API key that identifies a member account. You can obtain it from the Ruiyi Bao console
parameters.help_zh: API密钥，标识成员账号身份，可通过睿译宝工作台获取
parameters.name: api_key
